title: refactor(panel): migrate Panel widget stack to TypeScript
body:
This migrates the Panel widget stack to TypeScript. This is a non-conventional widget that benefits from being typed.

This anticipates new APIs that we might want to introduce in v5 regarding simplifying its usage (perhaps passing UI state on top of the whole render options).

## Changes

- Migrate the Preact class component to a function (TypeScript + Preact class components don't work with our setup which is why hooks were used)
- The tests haven't changed. They were migrated to `@testing-library/preact`

## Impact

There is a small bundle size increase because we now import `preact/hooks`. This will get "absorbed" once we remove classes from the codebase.

## Preview

[See stories →](https://deploy-preview-4268--instantsearchjs.netlify.com/stories/?path=/story/basics-panel--default)

comments.body: I would have put the refactoring to hooks in a separate PR, it would make easier for us to see what changed during the migration.
@yannickcr I forgot to mention, class components do not work with our TypeScript + Preact setup, so that was not possible.

Oh, I'm interested in more details :slightly_smiling_face: 

But that's a good reason to make both at the same time then, worth mentioning it in the PR description tho :wink:

@Haroenv Nothing relevant in the tests, I just migrated to `@testing-library/preact`. You can try the [stories](https://deploy-preview-4268--instantsearchjs.netlify.com/stories/?path=/story/basics-panel--default).
